headline: 9 on-chain Solana addresses catalogued (stake pool + 8 authority/account addresses); no EVM addresses; protocol runs on Sanctum infrastructure.

findings.text: D1: Solana has no Etherscan-style name-tag search API. No EVM block explorer applies. Solana Compass (solanacompass.com) served as the primary on-chain explorer — fetched the stake pool page which lists all pool addresses with labelled roles. The pool address pyZMBjpWsVjKANAYK5mpNbKiws2krjRPZ2N2UYCSnbP was surfaced via a Sanctum search snippet (sctm...rQpx / pyZM...SnbP), then confirmed by fetching the Solana Compass page.

D2: No dedicated 'Deployed contracts' docs page found. The protocol website (defidevcorp.com/?tab=dfdvSOLcom) returned a JS-rendered shell with no parseable content. The Sanctum explore page (app.sanctum.so/explore/dfdvSOL) shows token and stake pool addresses but was blocked by domain permissions. Solana Compass served as the authoritative address source instead. protocol_metadata.deployed_contracts_doc set to null.

D3: No audit links provided in per-protocol context. No audit PDFs discovered via website or GitHub walk. Sanctum's own infrastructure (sanctum-pools on-chain program) has separate audits not specific to this LST instance. No dfdvSOL-specific audit found.

D4: No GitHub repo recorded in per-protocol context (protocol.github = none). Search and website fetch did not surface a DFDV-specific smart-contract repo. Sanctum's infrastructure code lives at github.com/igneous-labs (surfaced from Sanctum blog footer) but was not fetched this run — no commit SHA available.
D5: Protocol operates exclusively on Solana (single chain). No multi-chain enumeration required.

D6: The stake pool (pyZMBjpWsVjKANAYK5mpNbKiws2krjRPZ2N2UYCSnbP) is not a factory. It has 2 active validators as of epoch 990. The validator list storage account (6rVhWZ2JnWd8L7Ar7mJTSBAvDSixpuNSiLYrMMnyDm3d) enumerates validators but DeFiPunkd read-API does not support Solana (chainId not in supported list). On-chain validator enumeration not performed this run.

D7: Role taxonomy applied to all 9 addresses: stake pool (pool), pool token mint (token), manager (admin), staker (admin), stake deposit authority (other), pool withdraw authority (other), validator list storage (other), manager fee account (treasury), reserve stake (vault). All actor_class set to unknown as bytecode type was not read this run.

D8: All 9 addresses trace to the fetched Solana Compass page (https://solanacompass.com/stake-pools/pyZMBjpWsVjKANAYK5mpNbKiws2krjRPZ2N2UYCSnbP). Addresses are Solana base58 (32-byte), not EVM hex (20-byte), and cannot satisfy the admin_addresses[].address schema constraint ^0x[0-9a-fA-F]{40}$. Recorded in unknowns[] with D8 prefix; downstream runs must handle Solana address format.

rationale.verdict: Walked protocol website (JS-only shell), Sanctum blog, Decrypt article, Solana Compass stake pool page, and multiple press releases. 9 on-chain Solana addresses catalogued from the Solana Compass fetch (stake pool, token mint, manager, staker, 2 authorities, validator list, fee account, reserve). No EVM addresses exist — the protocol is Solana-native. Schema requires EVM hex addresses in admin_addresses[], so all addresses are relegated to evidence[] and unknowns[]; downstream slices must extend the schema or handle base58 natively.

protocol_metadata.about: DFDV Staked SOL (dfdvSOL) is a liquid staking token (LST) on Solana issued by DeFi Development Corp. (Nasdaq: DFDV), a US public company whose treasury strategy centers on accumulating and compounding SOL. Users stake SOL to DFDV-operated validators and receive dfdvSOL, an interest-bearing receipt token that accrues staking rewards automatically and can be used across Solana DeFi protocols. The token is built and managed using Sanctum's staking-as-a-service infrastructure, which handles stake pool management, yield accrual, and LST composability; the on-chain program used is Sanctum's 'sanctum-pools' program. As of July 2026, the pool holds approximately 825,000 SOL across 2 validators with a 5.87% APY.
